settings.heading: About Vegas TV Mounting
settings.paragraph: At Vegas TV Mounting, our purpose is to make technology work better in the spaces where people live and do business. We combine professional installation expertise with personalized service to help our customers create cleaner, smarter, and more connected spaces. From TV mounting and home entertainment to smart-home technology and commercial A/V solutions, we proudly serve homes and businesses throughout the Las Vegas Valley.

settings.text: Built on Experience. Focused on What’s Next.

Technology has become an essential part of everyday life, but getting it professionally installed shouldn't be complicated. Vegas TV Mounting was built to deliver a better experience; combining skilled installation, straightforward service, and modern convenience from the first interaction to the finished project.

Our experience goes back to 2015, with more than 10,000 installations completed across Las Vegas, Philadelphia, and Atlanta. Over the years, our technicians have worked across a wide range of residential and commercial environments, building hands-on experience with everything from everyday installations to complex, custom projects.

Today, our capabilities extend well beyond TV mounting. Our team includes experienced technicians with specialized skills across home entertainment, custom A/V solutions, smart-home technology, networking, security, lighting, and commercial installations, allowing us to match the right experience to the needs of each project.

As Vegas TV Mounting looks to the future, we're building more than an installation company. We're creating a modern technology service experience built around skilled professionals, smarter systems, greater convenience, and an uncompromising standard of workmanship. Our vision is to continue raising the standard for how technology is installed and supported—giving every customer the expertise of a specialist, the convenience of a modern platform, and the confidence of knowing their project is in experienced hands.

settings.heading: Justin Jones Founder, Vegas TV Mounting
settings.paragraph:
Justin is an operations executive with experience across technology, real estate, and business development.

Throughout his career, two principles have shaped how Justin builds and operates businesses: exceptional quality and exceptional service. His approach is simple; surround the company with talented people who take pride in their craft, give them the tools and standards to perform at a high level, and never settle for simply meeting a customer's expectations when there is an opportunity to exceed them.

That philosophy is at the center of Vegas TV Mounting. Justin's focus is on building a team of experienced technicians with specialized expertise, including professionals capable of handling advanced and custom installations.

As technology continues to shape the way our community lives and works, Justin remains focused on what’s next: expanding our capabilities, embracing innovation, and becoming the name Las Vegas trusts for technology in their homes and businesses.

settings.heading: Tim Caruso, Strategy Vegas TV Mounting
settings.paragraph:
Tim brings more than 25 years of experience in technology, audiovisual systems, and commercial solutions to Vegas TV Mounting. He holds a Professional Master’s in Network Engineering from the University of Colorado Boulder and has built his career around understanding not only how technology works, but how to make it work better.

Tim believes great technology companies cannot afford to stand still. New systems, standards, products, and capabilities are constantly changing the industry, and staying ahead requires experience, discipline, and the willingness to evolve.

At Vegas TV Mounting, Tim helps drive the technical direction behind the company. From complex commercial projects and advanced AV solutions to evaluating new technologies and strengthening our technical standards, his role is to ensure our capabilities continue moving forward.
